goals_empty_filtered_body: Nothing here matches the search and period you picked. Clearing the filter shows everything you can see.
goals_empty_admin_body: A goal is a target and a period. Once one exists, closed-won deals count towards it automatically. Nobody has to update a number.
goals_empty_member_body: Nothing is assigned to you or your teams. An administrator sets these, and closed-won deals count towards them automatically once one exists.
goals_card_weighted_title: Some deal types count at an adjusted value
goals_leaderboard_empty: Nothing to rank yet. The board covers monthly goals running today, and shows the ones you can see: your own, and your teams'.
goals_leaderboard_note: Ranked on attainment against each person's own target, not on raw revenue. Otherwise the biggest patch wins every quarter regardless of who worked hardest.
goals_form_new_admins_text: Setting goals is limited to admins. Ask an admin on your team to add a quota or target.
goals_form_edit_admins_text: Changing goals is limited to admins. Ask an admin on your team to adjust a quota or target.
goals_form_new_sub: A target and a period. Closed-won deals count towards it automatically.
goals_form_name_hint: What you would say out loud, “Q3 revenue, Priya”, not “Goal 14”.
goals_form_name_error: Give the goal a name you would recognise in a list.
goals_form_type_hint: Revenue counts closed-won amounts, deals counts closed-won deals, and activities counts the records this person touched.
goals_form_target_invalid: Target has to be a number greater than zero.
goals_form_currency_hint: Only closed-won deals in this currency count toward the target. Amounts are never converted between currencies.
goals_form_period_hint: A label for the window below. The dates are what actually scope it.
goals_form_end_before_start: The end has to be after the start.
goals_form_owner_hint: Progress is scoped to whoever this is aimed at. Only people and teams in your org appear here, the server refuses any other.
goals_delete_hint: A finished goal is usually better paused than deleted. Paused keeps its history. Delete only when it was created by mistake.
goals_error_create_forbidden: Only an admin can create goals.
goals_error_not_found: That goal does not exist, or you cannot see it.
goals_error_save_forbidden: Only an admin can change goals.
goals_error_delete_forbidden: Only an admin can delete goals.
goals_history_sub: Finished periods, newest first. A closed period is settled, so these are results rather than pace.
goals_history_empty_body: Once a goal's period ends it moves here with what it attained. Goals still running are on the goals page.
goals_history_note: The twelve most recent periods you can see. Attainment is recomputed from the closed-won deals of each period, so it matches what the goals page showed while the period was running.
